name: Static monitoring (SoundTrap)
description:
Configuration for static SoundTrap deployments recorded with the on-board click detector running. Extracts the stored click detections while the audio is processed, and adds whistle and moan detectors at both full and low frequency, a long term spectral average, noise band monitoring and displays, with database and binary storage.

Only offered when the imported sud files actually contain click detections - there would be nothing for the SoundTrap Click Detector to do otherwise.
author: PAMGuard
